note: Ten bipolar axes. Structure after the public-domain IPIP item pool (ipip.ori.org); every word here is original to Pathfinder GM (2026-09-25). A score is rolled on a bell curve (3d6 scaled to 0-100): 40-60 is the silent middle and says nothing. Below 40 speaks the low pole, above 60 the high pole; the three words are for 25-39 / 61-75, 10-24 / 76-90, and the extremes. A person is voiced by their two most extreme axes (three when a third is past 85 or under 15). Each pole's id is the tag other tables are checked against. shows: one line of how it comes out in a scene, for the model. No cross-axis exclusions: opposites share one axis, so they cannot both be rolled, and every pairing across axes reads as a person (a timid gossip, a kind miser) — contradiction is what the other tables are checked against these tags for.
